Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 1
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly classified "trees" as non-renewable and "aluminum" as renewable. In standard educational contexts and general definitions, trees are the primary example of a renewable resource (biomass) because they can be replanted and regrow within a human timeframe. Aluminum is a non-renewable mineral resource; while it is highly recyclable, the raw material itself is finite and extracted from the earth, meaning it is not renewable in the same sense as trees. The Planner's definition of renewable ("replenished on human timescales") was applied incorrectly to trees (ignoring regrowth) and incorrectly to aluminum (confusing recyclability with renewability).
